name: User - Default (seed v1)
description: A player account: Minecraft identity, web login, progress, currencies and groups. Currencies, experience and multipliers change only on the Player profile page.

sections.description: Who the player is in Minecraft and on the web app.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: The player's name, shown in game and on the web app.

fields.label: Minecraft UUID
fields.description: The player's permanent Minecraft account id. Empty for a web account not linked to Minecraft yet.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Used to log in to the web app. Empty for players who only play in game.

fields.label: Email verified
fields.description: The player confirmed the email address.

fields.label: Web account
fields.description: On when the account has an email and a password, so the player can log in to the web app.

fields.label: Created via
fields.description: WebApp or MinecraftServer: where the account was first made.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: When the account was made.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Off for a deactivated (soft-deleted) account: the player can't log in.

sections.description: Read-only here: balances and experience change only with Adjust balance on the Player profile page, which checks and logs every change.

fields.label: Coins
fields.description: The player's coin balance, earned by playing and salary.

fields.label: Gems
fields.description: The player's gem balance; gems pay for warps and other extras.

fields.label: Experience
fields.description: Total experience points. They decide the player's title.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The title bracket the experience reaches, worked out from the experience; not stored.

fields.label: Prestige experience
fields.description: Experience above the top title's minimum. 0 until the player holds the top title.

fields.label: Salary multiplier
fields.description: Personal factor on the player's salary. 1 = normal.

sections.description: The player's premium tier, from the premium permission groups they are in.

fields.label: Premium tier
fields.description: The highest premium group the player holds. Empty without one.

fields.label: Premium until
fields.description: When that membership ends. Empty for a permanent tier or no tier.

sections.description: The groups the player is in, including inherited ones, highest precedence first. Edit opens the group itself, not the membership.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Name of the permission group.

sections.description: Preferences the player sets in game.

fields.label: Gate pass-through
fields.description: How the player passes a closed gate that allows it: Default (the door opens briefly), InstantOpen (only the blocks in the way vanish) or Teleport (to the other side). Set in game with /knk gate passthrough.

fields.label: Staff mode
fields.description: None, Staff or Owner, set in game with /staffmode or /ownermode. Any mode but None hides the player from others.

fields.label: Gender
fields.description: Picks the male or female form of title names. Empty = the default form.

sections.description: Whether the player is online, and whether staff froze them.

fields.label: Online
fields.description: The player is on the server right now. Reported by the server.

fields.label: Last seen
fields.description: When the player was last online.

fields.label: Frozen
fields.description: Staff froze the player: they can't move or act until unfrozen.

fields.label: Freeze reason
fields.description: Why staff froze the player.

notes: TitleName, PrestigeExperience, PremiumTierName, PremiumTierExpiresAt are computed on the read DTO; PermissionGroups is the DTO list of effective groups (model: PermissionGroupMemberships of UserPermissionGroup), hence metadataCheck "warn".
Nothing is hot-editable: the generic update ignores Coins/Gems/ExperiencePoints (KNG-22) and requires an email, so editing Username of an in-game-only player fails.
